title: Long Primer PCR for Trypanosoma brucei
author: Alex Zegarra
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgcnjsve
materials: PRC Mix 1 uL pPOT (25 ng/uL) 0.2 mM dNTPs 1 uM for primer 1 uM rev primer 1 uL PCR grade DMSO 5uL 10x buffer 2 (Roche) XX uL ddH20 for total volume of 49 uL Add 1 uL Expand High Fidelity polymerase (Roche) once mixture has reached 94 C.
Electroporate the cell once with 1.7 kV, 25 mF (gene pulser (Bio-Rad) or three times 1.7 kV for 100 Ms, 200 ms interval (BTX ECM830 (hardvard Apparatus))

steps.title: Prepare Procyclic Form Cells
steps.instruction: Maintain procyclic form SMOX P9 cells between 1x10^6 - 1x10^7 cells ml^-1 for at least 72 hours prior to transfection to ensure they are in log growth phase.

steps.title: Perform Long Primer PCR
steps.instruction: Run PCR using the following conditions: 94°C for 5 mins; then 30 cycles of (94°C for 15 sec, 65°C for 30 sec); followed by 72°C for 2 min and 72°C for 7 min.

steps.title: Prepare Procyclic Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Process 1x10^7 log phase procyclic cells per transfection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 800 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in 500 mL of room temperature cytomix per transfection.
Add the suspension to a 4 mm gap electroporation cuvette.

steps.title: Electroporate Procyclic Cells
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of unpurified PCR product to the cell suspension and electroporate.

steps.title: Recover Procyclic Cells
steps.instruction: Recover the cells for 8-16 hours in 10 ml SDM-79 at 28°C.

steps.title: Select Procyclic Cells
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate selective drug to the final concentration: Blasticidin (Melford) 20mg/ml (Note: 25mg/ml reduces transfection efficiency due to low readthrough transcription of the resistance cassette).

steps.title: Isolate Procyclic Clones
steps.instruction: If clones are required, dilute 5 ml of recovered cells into 50 ml of selective medium and distribute 1 ml aliquots into a 48 well plate.

steps.title: Purify Long Primer PCR Product
steps.instruction: Purify 100ml of long primer PCR (~8mg) using phenol chloroform extraction and ethanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Perform ethanol precipitation at -80°C for 1 hour.
Wash the pellet twice with 70% ethanol.
Resuspend the dried pellet in 10ml 5mM Tris pH8.

steps.title: Prepare Bloodstream Form Cells
steps.instruction: Maintain bloodstream form SMOX B4 cells between 1x10^5–1x10^6 cells ml^-1 for at least 72 hours prior to transfection to ensure they are in log growth phase.

steps.title: Prepare Bloodstream Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Process 2x10^7 log phase (<1.3x10^6 cells ml^-1) bloodstream form cells per transfection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 800 g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Complete the human T-cell Nucleofector solution (VPA-1002 Lonza) by adding supplement 1.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100ml of complete Amaxa T cell buffer per transfection.
Transfer the suspension to an Amaxa cuvette.

steps.title: Electroporate Bloodstream Cells
steps.instruction: Add the purified DNA to the cell suspension and electroporate once using Program X-001.

steps.title: Recover Bloodstream Cells
steps.instruction: Recover cells for 8-16 hours in 50 ml HMI-9 at 37°C with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Select Bloodstream Cells
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate selective drug to the final concentrations: Blasticidin (Melford) 5mg/ml or Hygromycin B Gold (Invivogen) 1.5mg/ml.

steps.title: Plate Bloodstream Cells
steps.instruction: Distribute 1ml aliquots of cells into two 48 well plates.
